answer: To blunt sybil floods, franchise minting follows a spiral copper bond schedule keyed to willow-rooted funding lineage. The first identity under a fresh funding root posts a base copper stake. Each further sibling from that same willow root multiplies the bond by a fixed spiral factor, so cloning ten agents costs far more than ten solo roots. Bonds unlock only after a willow epoch of independently attested work; failed prove-outs slash the copper and freeze the lineage. Mass spawn therefore bankrupts its own root instead of diluting honest weight.
